ααρων.def: Aaron, son of Amram and Jochebed, brother of Moses.

αβαδδων.def: Abaddon, Destroyer (i.e. Destroying Angel) or "place of destruction" (personified).

αβαρησ.def: not burdensome, bringing no weight or oppression upon.

αβελ.def: Abel, second son of Adam and Eve, brother of Cain.

αβια.def: Abijah, (a) a king, son of Rehoboam, (b) founder of the eighth class of priests.

αβιαθαρ.def: Abiathar, a priest in King David's time.

αβιληνη.def: the Abilenian territory, the territory of Abila (in Syria), a small principality in the mountains of Damascus.

αβιουδ.def: Abiud, son of Zerubbabel and father of Eliakim.

αβρααμ.def: Abraham, progenitor of the Hebrew race.

αβυσσοσ.def: the abyss, unfathomable depth, an especially Jewish conception, the home of the dead and of evil spirits.

αγαθοεργεω.def: I work that which is good, perform good deeds.

αγαθοποιεω.gloss: I do that which is good
αγαθοποιεω.def: I do that which is good.

αγαθοποιια.gloss: the doing of that which is good
αγαθοποιια.def: the doing of that which is good, well-doing.

αγαθοποιοσ.gloss: a doer of that which is good
αγαθοποιοσ.def: a doer of that which is good.

αγαθοσ.def: intrinsically good, good in nature, good whether it be seen to be so or not, the widest and most colorless of all words with this meaning.

αγαθωσυνη.def: intrinsic goodness, especially as a personal quality, with stress on the kindly (rather than the righteous) side of goodness.

αγαλλιασισ.def: wild joy, ecstatic delight, exultation, exhilaration.

αγαλλιαω.gloss: I exult, am full of joy
αγαλλιαω.def: I exult, am full of joy.

αγαμοσ.def: unmarried, of a person not in a state of wedlock, whether he or she has formerly been married or not.

αγαπαω.def: I love, wish well to, take pleasure in, long for; denotes the love of reason, esteem.

αγαπη.def: love, benevolence, good will, esteem; plur: love-feasts.

αγαπητοσ.def: loved, beloved, with two special applications: the Beloved, a title of the Messiah (Christ), as beloved beyond all others by the God who sent Him; of Christians, as beloved by God, Christ, and one another.

αγαρ.def: Hagar, the servant of Sarah, concubine of Abraham.

αγγαρευω.def: I impress (into my service), send (on an errand).

αγγελοσ.def: a messenger, generally a (supernatural) messenger from God, an angel, conveying news or behests from God to men.

αγενεαλογητοσ.def: of unrecorded genealogy, whose descent cannot be traced.

αγενησ.def: lit: without family, hence: ignoble, base.

αγιαζω.def: I make holy, treat as holy, set apart as holy, sanctify, hallow, purify.

αγιασμοσ.def: the process of making or becoming holy, set apart, sanctification, holiness, consecration.

αγιοσ.def: set apart by (or for) God, holy, sacred.

αγιοτησ.def: holiness, sanctity, as an abstract quality.

αγκαλη.def: an arm, especially as bent to receive a burden.

αγνιζω.def: I cleanse, purify, either ceremonially, actually, or morally.

αγνοεω.gloss: I do not know, am ignorant of
αγνοεω.def: I do not know, am ignorant of (a person, thing, or fact), sometimes with the idea of willful ignorance.

αγνοημα.def: an offence committed through ignorance, an error due to (willful or culpable) ignorance.

αγνοια.def: ignorance, inadvertence, sometimes with the idea of willful blindness.

αγνοσ.def: (originally, in a condition prepared for worship), pure (either ethically, or ritually, ceremonially), chaste.

αγνωσ.def: purely, sincerely, with pure motives, honestly.

αγορα.def: market-place, forum, public place of assembly.

αγοραιοσ.def: a lounger in the market-place, perhaps with the idea of agitator.

αγραμματοσ.def: unlettered, illiterate, uneducated, perhaps with the narrower idea: unacquainted with Rabbinic teaching.

αγραυλεω.gloss: I spend the night in the open
αγραυλεω.def: I spend the night in the open, bivouac.

αγροσ.def: a field, especially as bearing a crop; the country, lands, property in land, a country estate.

αγρυπνεω.def: I am not asleep, am awake; especially: I am watchful, careful.

αγρυπνια.def: the state of being awake (at night), sleeplessness, watching.

αγω.def: I lead, lead away, bring (a person, or animal), guide, spend a day, go.

αγωγη.def: a leading, guiding; hence: mode of life, conduct.

αγων.def: an (athletic) contest; hence, a struggle (in the soul).

αγωνια.def: (properly the feeling of the athlete before a contest), great fear, terror, of death; anxiety, agony.

αγωνιζομαι.def: I am struggling, striving (as in an athletic contest or warfare); I contend, as with an adversary.

αδαμ.def: Adam, the first man, the first parent of the human race.

αδαπανοσ.def: without expense, for which nothing has to be paid.

αδδι.def: Addi, son of Cosam, and father of Melchi, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

αδελφη.def: a sister, a woman (fellow-)member of a church, a Christian woman.

αδελφοσ.def: a brother, member of the same religious community, especially a fellow-Christian.

αδελφοτησ.def: brotherhood (in the collective sense), the members of the Christian Church, Christendom.

αδηλοτησ.def: the quality of being unseen (of disappearing), indefiniteness, uncertainty.

αδηλωσ.def: out of sight, obscurely, inconspicuously, uncertainly, without certain aim.

αδημονεω.def: I feel fear, lack courage, am distressed, troubled.

αδικεω.def: I act unjustly towards, injure, harm.

αδικημα.def: a legal wrong, crime (with which one is charged), misdeed, crime against God, a sin.

αδοκιμοσ.def: failing to pass the test, unapproved, counterfeit.

αδραμυττηνοσ.def: belonging to Adramyttium, a port in Mysia, in Asia Minor.

αδριασ.def: the Hadria, a name given by sailors not merely to the Adriatic Sea, to which it properly belonged, but also to the open Mediterranean to the south-east of Italy, to the sea that lay between Malta, Italy, Greece, and Crete.

αδυνατεω.def: to be impossible; I am unable.

αδυνατοσ.def: of persons: incapable; of things: impossible; either the inability, or that which is impossible.

αει.def: always, unceasingly, perpetually; on every occasion.

αζυμοσ.def: unleavened, the paschal feast (a feast of the Hebrews); fig: uncorrupted, sincere.

αζωρ.def: Azor, son of Eliakim and father of Zadok, an ancestor of Jesus.

αζωτοσ.def: Azotus, Ashdod, a coast town of Palestine belonging to the ancient Philistia, and part of Herod's kingdom.

αηρ.def: air, the lower air we breathe.

αθεοσ.def: without god, without (the only true) God, godless.

αθετεω.def: I annul, make of no effect, set aside, ignore, slight; I break faith with.

αθηναι.def: Athens, the intellectual capital of Greece.

αθλεω.def: I engage, compete, in an (athletic) contest.

αθλησισ.def: a struggling (as in an athletic contest).

αθυμεω.def: I lose heart, am despondent, am disheartened.

αιγιαλοσ.def: sea-coast, (sandy) beach; shore (of sea or lake), land.

αιματεκχυσια.gloss: a shedding or pouring forth of blood
αιματεκχυσια.def: a shedding or pouring forth of blood (in sacrifice).

αιμορροεω.gloss: I suffer from a continual flow (oozing) of blood
αιμορροεω.def: I suffer from a continual flow (oozing) of blood.

αινων.def: Aenon; Eusebius and Jerome place this site 8 (Roman) miles south of Scythopolis near the Jordan.

αιρεσισ.def: a self-chosen opinion, a religious or philosophical sect, discord or contention.

αιρετικοσ.def: disposed to form sects, sectarian, heretical, factious.

αιρω.def: I raise, lift up, take away, remove.

αισχροκερδωσ.def: greedily, in a spirit of eagerness for base gain.

αισχυνομαι.gloss: I am ashamed, am put to shame
αισχυνομαι.def: I am ashamed, am put to shame.

αιτια.def: a cause, reason, excuse; a charge, accusation; guilt; circumstances, case.

αιτιοσ.gloss: the cause of, the originator of
αιτιοσ.def: the cause, author; the culprit, the accused; the crime.

αιχμαλωτιζω.def: I take captive (in war); I subdue, ensnare.

αιων.gloss: an age, a cycle of time
αιων.def: an age, a cycle (of time), especially of the present age as contrasted with the future age, and of one of a series of ages stretching to infinity.

αιωνιοσ.def: age-long, and therefore: practically eternal, unending; partaking of the character of that which lasts for an age, as contrasted with that which is brief and fleeting.

ακαιρεομαι.gloss: I am without a suitable opportunity
ακαιρεομαι.def: I am without a suitable opportunity.

ακαιρωσ.def: unseasonably, out of due season, inopportunely.

ακανθα.def: a thorn-bush, prickly plant; a thorn.

ακαταγνωστοσ.def: not open to just rebuke; irreprehensible.

ακαταλυτοσ.gloss: indissoluble, that cannot be broken up
ακαταλυτοσ.def: indissoluble, that cannot be broken up.

ακαταπαυστοσ.def: not ceasing from, not abandoning (giving up).

ακαταστασια.def: disturbance, upheaval, revolution, almost anarchy, first in the political, and thence in the moral sphere.

ακαταστατοσ.def: unsettled, unstable (though these are hardly strong enough equivalents), almost anarchic.

ακμαζω.def: I reach maturity, become ripe, am in full vigor.

ακοη.def: hearing, faculty of hearing, ear; report, rumor.

ακουω.def: I hear, listen, comprehend by hearing; pass: is heard, reported.

ακρασια.def: incontinence, intemperance (in wide sense), lack of restraint.

ακρατησ.def: lacking self-control, powerless, inclined to excess.

ακριβεια.def: strictness, accuracy, exactness, attention to detail, scrupulousness.

ακριβοω.def: I learn carefully, inquire with exactness.

ακροατηριον.def: auditorium, recitation hall, court room (for hearing cases).

ακροατησ.gloss: a hearer of, a listener to
ακροατησ.def: a hearer of, a listener to.

ακροβυστια.def: (a technical word of Jewish use) foreskin, prepuce: used sometimes as a slang term by Jews, of Gentiles.

ακρογωνιαιοσ.def: in the corner (of a building); subst: corner-(stone).

ακροθινιον.def: (lit: top of a heap), first-fruits, spoil, treasure (taken in war).

ακυλασ.def: the Greek way of writing the Latin Aquila, a male proper name; the husband of Priscilla (Prisca), and a Jew, of a family belonging to (Sinope in ?) Pontus.

ακυροω.gloss: I annul, make of no effect, cancel
ακυροω.def: I annul, make of no effect, cancel.

ακωλυτωσ.def: (characteristic of legal documents), without hindrance, freely.

ακων.def: unwilling, generally used where English would express by an adverb: unwillingly.

αλαβαστρον.def: a phial or bottle of perfumed ointment, usually of alabaster.

αλαζονεια.def: boasting, show, arrogant display, ostentation; plur: occasions of ostentation.

αλαζων.def: a boaster, one who gives one's self airs in a loud and flaunting way.

αλαλαζω.gloss: I cry aloud, a clanging or clashing cymbal
αλαλαζω.def: I cry aloud, raise a war-cry; a clanging or clashing cymbal.

αλαλοσ.def: unable to speak or articulate; speechless.

αλειφω.def: I anoint: festivally, in homage, medicinally, or in anointing the dead.

αλεκτοροφωνια.def: the cockcrow, as a period of time, between midnight and 3 a.m.

αλεξανδρευσ.def: an Alexandrian, a native (or resident) of Alexandria in Egypt.

αλεξανδρινοσ.def: Alexandrian, belonging to Alexandria in Egypt.

αλεξανδροσ.def: Alexander, a name of Greek origin, (a) son of Simon of Cyrene, (b) the High Priest's kinsman, (c) an Ephesian Jew, (d) the coppersmith.

αληθεια.def: truth, but not merely truth as spoken; truth of idea, reality, sincerity, truth in the moral sphere, divine truth revealed to man, straightforwardness.

αληθευω.gloss: I say, speak truth, I do truth
αληθευω.def: I say (speak) truth, do truth, maintain truth (the truth).

αληθησ.def: unconcealed, true, true in fact, worthy of credit, truthful.

αληθινοσ.def: true (lit: made of truth), real, genuine.

αλιζω.gloss: I salt, sprinkle with salt, keep fresh and sound
αλιζω.def: I salt, sprinkle with salt (of sacrifices or of those who offer sacrifice), keep fresh and sound, and so acceptable to God.

αλισγημα.def: pollution, perhaps a polluted thing (especially of food).

αλλαχοθεν.gloss: from another quarter, by another way
αλλαχοθεν.def: from another place, by another way.

αλλομαι.def: I leap, leap up; of water: I spring up, bubble up.

αλλοσ.def: other, another (of more than two), different.

αλλοτριοεπισκοποσ.gloss: a prier into other men's affairs
αλλοτριοεπισκοποσ.def: one who meddles in things alien to his calling or in matters belonging to others; factious.

αλλοτριοσ.def: belonging to another person, belonging to others, foreign, strange.

αλλοφυλοσ.def: foreign, of another tribe or race.

αλογοσ.def: without reason, irrational; contrary to reason, absurd.

αλοη.def: aloes, the powdered fragrant aloe wood.

αλφα.gloss: the first letter of the Greek alphabet
αλφα.def: alpha; the first letter of the Greek alphabet.

αλφαιοσ.def: Alphaeus; apparently two persons, (a) father of Levi, and (b) father of James.

αλωπηξ.def: a fox; a fox-like, crafty person.

αμα.gloss: at the same time, along with
αμα.def: at the same time, therewith, along with, together with.

αμαρτανω.def: originally: I miss the mark, hence (a) I make a mistake, (b) I sin, commit a sin (against God); sometimes the idea of sinning against a fellow-creature is present.

αμαρτια.def: prop: missing the mark; hence: (a) guilt, sin, (b) a fault, failure (in an ethical sense), sinful deed.

αμαχοσ.def: peaceable, abstaining from fighting, not contentious.

αμεθυστοσ.def: amethyst (a kind of rock crystal: the best specimens are the color of unmixed wine, whence perhaps the name), believed to stave off drunkenness.

αμελεω.def: I neglect, am careless of, disregard.

αμεμπτοσ.def: blameless, free from fault or defect.

αμεριμνοσ.def: free from anxiety (though anxiety is rather too strong a word) or care.

αμεταμελητοσ.def: not to be repented of, about which no change of mind can take place, not affected by change of mind.

αμετροσ.def: not measurable, immeasurable, to a limitless degree.

αμην.gloss: verily, truly, amen, so let it be
αμην.def: verily, truly, amen; at the end of sentences may be paraphrased by: So let it be.

αμητωρ.gloss: whose mother's name is not recorded or known
αμητωρ.def: (lit: motherless), whose mother's name is not recorded (or known).

αμιναδαβ.def: Amminadab, son of Ram and father of Nahshon, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

αμνοσ.def: a lamb (as a type of innocence, and with sacrificial connotation).

αμοιβη.def: a change, an exchange; hence plur: reciprocal good deeds (services), a fitting requital.

αμπλιασ.def: Ampliatus (Amplias), a male member of the church at Rome, probably of the imperial household.

αμυνομαι.def: I ward off, defend myself against, resist, defend, assist.

αμφιβληστρον.def: prop: something thrown around; a fishing-net, drag-net.

αμφιπολισ.def: Amphipolis, a leading city of Macedonia.

αμφοδον.def: prop: a road around anything; the street of a village.

αμων.def: Amon (Amos), son of Manasseh and father of Josiah, an ancestor of Jesus.

αμωσ.def: Amos, son of Manasseh and father of Josiah, an ancestor of Jesus.

αν.gloss: an untranslatable word that makes a statement contingent
αν.def: an untranslatable word (under the circumstances, in that case, anyhow), the general effect of which is to make a statement contingent, which would otherwise be definite: it is thus regularly used with the subjunctive mood.

ανα.gloss: and, apiece, by, each, every, in, through
ανα.def: prep. Rare in NT; prop: upwards, up; among, between; in turn; apiece, by; as a prefix: up, to, anew, back.

αναβαθμοσ.gloss: a step, a flight of steps
αναβαθμοσ.def: a step, a flight of steps; the well-known "stairs" leading up from the temple to the tower of Antonia at Jerusalem.

αναβαινω.def: I go up, mount, ascend; of things: I rise, spring up, come up.

αναβαλλω.def: I postpone, defer, especially: I postpone the trial of.

αναβιβαζω.def: I draw up, as a net to shore.

αναβλεπω.gloss: I look up, recover my sight
αναβλεπω.def: I look up, recover my sight.

αναβοαω.gloss: I shout upwards, cry out, raise my voice
αναβοαω.def: I shout upwards, cry out, raise my voice.

αναγγελλω.def: I bring back word, report; I announce, declare.

αναγενναω.gloss: I beget again, beget into a new life
αναγενναω.def: I beget again, beget into a new life.

αναγινωσκω.def: I read, know again, know certainly, recognize, discern.

αναγκαστωσ.def: by way of compulsion, unwillingly, by force, necessarily.

αναγκη.def: necessity, constraint, compulsion; there is need to; force, violence.

αναγνωριζω.gloss: I make known to again, make to be recognized
αναγνωριζω.def: I recognize; pass: I am made known, cause myself to be recognized.

αναγνωσισ.def: recognition, reading; public reading (of the law and prophets in synagogue or church).

αναγω.gloss: I lead up, put to sea, set sail
αναγω.def: I lead up, bring up, offer, produce, put to sea, set sail.

αναδεικνυμι.gloss: I show forth, show clearly, proclaim, appoint
αναδεικνυμι.def: I show forth, show clearly; hence: I proclaim (a person's appointment to an office), appoint.

αναδειξισ.def: the proclamation of an appointment (to an office); perhaps rather admission to membership of a society.

αναδεχομαι.def: I welcome, receive kindly; I undertake, assume the responsibility of.

αναδιδωμι.gloss: I send up, deliver, hand over
αναδιδωμι.def: I send up, deliver, hand over, yield.

αναζαω.gloss: I come to life again, revive
αναζαω.def: I come to life again, revive, regain life.

αναζητεω.def: I seek out, search for (implying the difficulty of the task).

αναζωννυμι.def: I gird up, brace up (with a view to active exertion); a metaphor from the girding of the flowing tunic, to prevent its hampering one in active work.

αναζωπυρεω.gloss: I stir up the fire, fan the flame of
αναζωπυρεω.def: I stir up the fire, fan the flame of.

αναθαλλω.def: I thrive or flourish again, revive.

αναθεμα.def: a votive offering, a thing devoted to God; a curse, the thing cursed.

αναθεματιζω.def: I curse, invoke curses, devote to destruction.

αναθεωρεω.def: I look at attentively, gaze at, consider.

αναθημα.gloss: an offering dedicated by a worshipper
αναθημα.def: an offering dedicated (hung up in a temple) by a worshipper; a gift or offering consecrated to God.

αναιρεσισ.def: taking away (of life), killing, slaying, murder.

αναιρεω.def: I take up, take away the life of, make an end of, murder.

ανακαινιζω.def: I make fresh again, renew, restore.

ανακαινωσισ.def: renewing; a renewal or change of heart and life.

ανακαμπτω.def: I bend or turn back; I return.

ανακειμαι.gloss: I recline, especially at a dinner-table
ανακειμαι.def: I recline, especially at a dinner-table.

ανακεφαλαιοω.gloss: I sum up, summarize, recapitulate, gather up in one
ανακεφαλαιοω.def: I sum up, summarize, recapitulate, gather up in one.

ανακλινω.gloss: I make to recline, I recline at a table
ανακλινω.def: I lay upon, lean against, lay down, make to recline; pass: I lie back, recline.

ανακρινω.def: I examine, inquire into, investigate, question.

ανακυπτω.def: I raise myself, look up, am elated.

αναλαμβανω.def: I take up, raise; I pick up, take on board; I carry off, lead away.

αναλυσισ.def: a loosing, departing, departure (from this life); (Probably a metaphor from the yoking and unyoking of transport animals).

αναλυω.def: I unloose, unloose for departure, depart, return.

αναμενω.def: I await (one whose coming is expected).

αναμιμνησκω.def: I remind, admonish, am reminded, remind myself; pass: I remember, recall.

ανανεοω.def: I renew; mid: I renew myself, am renewed.

ανανηφω.gloss: I become sober again, recover sound sense
ανανηφω.def: I become sober again, recover sound sense.

ανανιασ.def: Ananias, (a) husband of Sapphira, a member of the early church at Jerusalem, (b) a member of the church at Damascus, (c) the high priest at Jerusalem.

αναντιρρητοσ.def: indisputable, undeniable, not to be contradicted.

αναπαυω.gloss: I make to rest, give rest to, rest, take my ease
αναπαυω.def: I make to rest, give rest to; mid. and pass: I rest, take my ease.

αναπειθω.gloss: I urge by evil persuasion, I tempt

αναπεμπω.gloss: I send up to a higher tribunal, I send back
αναπεμπω.def: I send up (to a higher tribunal), send back.

αναπιπτω.gloss: I lie down, recline, fall back upon
αναπιπτω.def: I lie down, recline (at a dinner-table), fall back upon (the breast of another person reclining at dinner).

αναπληροω.gloss: I fill up, make up, fulfill
αναπληροω.def: I fill up, make up, complete the measure of, fulfill, carry out the commands (provisions, etc.) of.

αναπτω.def: I kindle, set on fire, light.

αναριθμητοσ.def: uncountable, innumerable, that cannot be numbered.

ανασειω.gloss: I shake up, stir up, excite
ανασειω.def: I shake up, stir up, excite.

ανασκευαζω.def: I pervert, subvert, dismantle, unsettle, overthrow, destroy.

ανασπαω.def: I drag up, pull up, draw up, draw out.

αναστατοω.gloss: I turn upside down, upset, unsettle
αναστατοω.def: (perhaps a political metaphor), I turn upside down, upset, unsettle.

αναστρεφω.gloss: I overturn, turn upside down, return, mid. and pass: I conduct myself, live
αναστρεφω.def: I overturn; I turn back, return; I turn hither and thither; pass: I turn myself about; I sojourn, dwell; I conduct myself, behave, live.

αναστροφη.def: dealing with other men, conduct, life, behavior, manner of life.

ανατασσομαι.def: I arrange, draw up, compose, but perhaps: I set down from memory, restore from memory.

ανατελλω.gloss: I make to rise, I rise, shine
ανατελλω.def: I make to rise, I rise, shine (generally of the sun, and hence met.).

ανατιθημι.gloss: I lay a case before, impart, communicate, relate
ανατιθημι.def: I lay (a case) before, impart, communicate, declare, relate (with a view to consulting).

ανατολη.gloss: rising of the sun, the East
ανατολη.def: (a) rising of the sun, hence (b) (sing. and plur.) the quarter whence the sun rises, the East.

ανατρεπω.def: I overturn (lit. or met.), subvert, overthrow, corrupt.

ανατρεφω.def: I rear, bring up, nourish, educate.

αναφαινω.def: (a) a nautical term: I sight (a place), (b) mid: I appear (as it were, out of the unseen), (c) I bring to light, make to appear.

αναφερω.gloss: I carry up, lead up, offer up
αναφερω.def: (a) I carry up, lead up, (b) I offer up (on a high altar) as a sacrifice, offer up to God on high.

αναχυσισ.def: outpouring, excess, overflow, a pouring out.

αναχωρεω.def: I return, retire, withdraw, depart (underlying idea perhaps of taking refuge from danger or of going into retirement).

ανδραποδιστησ.def: an enslaver, one who forcibly enslaves, a kidnapper.

ανδρεασ.def: Andrew, brother of Simon Peter, and one of the apostles of Jesus, belonging to Bethsaida.

ανδριζομαι.gloss: I act like a man, am brave
ανδριζομαι.def: I act like a man, am brave.

ανδρονικοσ.def: Andronicus, a member of the Roman church, and a kinsman or fellow-tribesman of Paul.

ανεκδιηγητοσ.gloss: indescribable, that cannot be thoroughly related
ανεκδιηγητοσ.def: indescribable, that cannot be thoroughly related, inexpressible.

ανεμιζω.gloss: I am blown with the wind
ανεμιζω.def: I am blown with the wind (referring to the gentler motions of the air).

ανεμοσ.def: the wind; fig: applied to empty doctrines.

ανεξερευνητοσ.gloss: that cannot be searched into, inscrutable
ανεξερευνητοσ.def: that cannot be searched into, inscrutable, unfathomable.

ανεξικακοσ.def: enduring evil, patient of evil, patiently forbearing.

ανεπαισχυντοσ.gloss: having no cause to be ashamed
ανεπαισχυντοσ.def: having no cause to be ashamed.

απειραστοσ.def: untried, inexperienced, untempted, incapable of being tempted.

αποθεσισ.def: a putting off, a laying down.

απορριπτω.def: I throw away from, throw overboard.

αρπαγμοσ.def: spoil, an object of eager desire, a prize.

ατενιζω.gloss: I direct my gaze, look steadily
ατενιζω.def: I direct my gaze, look steadily.

ατιμαζω.def: I disgrace, treat disgracefully, dishonor, insult; I despise.

ατομοσ.gloss: an indivisible part of time, a moment
ατομοσ.def: (lit: that cannot be cut), an indivisible part of time, a moment.

ατοποσ.def: (lit: out of place, unusual, unbecoming), improper, unrighteous, perverse.

ατταλεια.def: Attalia, the port of Perga in Pamphylia.

αυγαζω.def: I flash, gleam, shine forth, appear white, bright; but perhaps: I see, see clearly, discern.

αυγουστοσ.def: Augustus, a title conferred on the first Roman Emperor, C. Iulius Octauianus, denoting sanctity (almost divinity).

αυθεντεω.def: I domineer, govern, have mastery over.

αυλη.def: court-yard, fore-court, sheep-fold; but it may be understood as: palace, house.

αυλιζομαι.def: I lodge in the open, lodge, pass the night.

αυξανω.gloss: I cause to increase, become greater, grow
αυξανω.def: (a) I cause to increase, become greater (b) I increase, grow.

αυστηροσ.def: grim, severe, strict, exacting, harsh, rigid.

αυτοσ.gloss: he, she, it, they, them, same
αυτοσ.def: he, she, it, they, them, same.

αυχμηροσ.def: (poetical, lit: dry and parched; then: squalid and rough), dingy, murky, obscure, dark, funereal.

αφανιζω.gloss: I cause to disappear, I hide, remove, disfigure
αφανιζω.def: I cause to disappear, hide, remove; I disfigure (probably by leaving unwashed for a long period), destroy.

αφεσισ.def: a sending away, a letting go, a release, pardon, complete forgiveness.

αφη.def: a band, fastening (hence, possibly: a ligament), joint.

αφιημι.gloss: I send away, release, remit, forgive, permit
αφιημι.def: (a) I send away, (b) I let go, release, permit to depart, (c) I remit, forgive, (d) I permit, suffer.

αφικνεομαι.def: I arrive at, reach, come to.

αφιλαγαθοσ.gloss: not loving that which is good
αφιλαγαθοσ.def: not loving that which is good.

αφιστημι.gloss: I lead away, seduce, depart, abstain from
αφιστημι.def: I make to stand away, draw away, repel, take up a position away from, withdraw from, leave, abstain from.

αφοραω.def: I look away from (something else) to, see distinctly.

αφοριζω.gloss: I rail off, separate, place apart
αφοριζω.def: I rail off, separate, place apart.

αφορμη.def: (a) a starting, a start, (b) cause, occasion, opportunity.

αφροσυνη.def: want of sense, foolishness, impiety, wickedness.

αχαζ.def: Ahaz, son of Jotham and father of Hezekiah.

αχαια.def: the Roman Province Achaia, governed by a proconsul, and practically conterminous with modern Greece before 1912.

αχειμ.def: Achim, son of Zadok and father of Eliud.

αχειροποιητοσ.gloss: not made by hand, not handmade

αχρειοω.def: (lit: I become sour, I turn, of milk), I am good for nothing, render useless; met: I become corrupt.

αχρι.gloss: as far as, up to, until
αχρι.def: as far as, up to, until, during.
